Rashi on Menachot 6b:15:1.hebrew: תנא אזאת תורת העולה סמיך - כדאמר במסכת נדה בפרק יוצא דופן (נדה דף מ:), תורה אחת לכל העולין, שאם עלו לא ירדו. והאי דנקט במה, קצת סמכא בעלמא היא, אבל עיקר טעמא מהתם יליף:
Rashi on Menachot 6b:15:1.english: The Tanna relies on "This is the law of the burnt offering" - As [the Gemara] says in Tractate Niddah in the chapter [entitled] Yotzei Dofan (Niddah 40b): "[There is] one law for all that ascend [the altar], that if they ascended, they shall not descend." And that which [the tanna] cited [a private] altar is merely a slight support, but the primary reason he derived from there.

Rashi on Menachot 6b:17:1.hebrew: וקמץ משם - מלא קומצו. רישיה דקרא כתיב (ויקרא ב׳:ב׳) והביאה אל בני אהרן הכהנים וקמץ משם, משמע: ממקום שרגלי הזר עומדים, שם קומץ. והיינו מקום דריסת רגלי ישראל, אחת עשרה אמה, ובמזרח הם. וקמ"ל דלא בעינן קמיצה בצפון כשאר קדשים, אלא כל העזרה כשרה לקומץ:
Rashi on Menachot 6b:17:1.english: And he shall remove from there - [The verse continues: “his handful.”] At the beginning of the verse, it is written (Leviticus 2:2): “And he shall bring it to Aaron’s sons the priests, and he shall remove from there” — which implies: From the place where the feet of the non-priest stand, there [the priest] removes [the handful]. And that is the place of the treading of the feet of Israelites, eleven cubits [wide], and they are in the east; and it teaches us that we do not require the removal of the handful [to be] in the north like other holy offerings, but rather the entire Courtyard is valid for removing the handful.

Rashi on Menachot 6b:19:1.hebrew: סתמא כתיב - וקמץ משם, ממקום שקמץ כבר והחזירו קומצה משום פסלות, (אחד) ואחד פסול שמאל ואחד פסול זרות במשמע:
Rashi on Menachot 6b:19:1.english: It is written in an unspecified manner - [The verse states:] "And he shall remove a handful from there" — from the place where he already removed a handful and returned its handful due to a disqualification (one); both the disqualification of the left [hand] and the disqualification of a non-priest are implied.

Rashi on Menachot 6b:20:1.hebrew: אלא קמ"ל רב דבקומץ ואפילו קידש - קומץ במתן כלי מכשיר בן בתירא, דאי לאו דקידש מיירי רב לא הוה משמע לן מידי:
Rashi on Menachot 6b:20:1.english: Rather, Rav teaches us that in the case of a handful, and even if he sanctified [it] - [Even if he sanctified the] handful by placing [it in a] vessel, Ben Beteira deems [it] fit; for if Rav were not dealing with [a case where] he sanctified [it], he would not have taught us anything.

Rashi on Menachot 6b:20:2.english: In what case is this said - That Ben Beteira validates [the offering] by returning [the handful].

Rashi on Menachot 6b:21:1.english: [To exclude] the first tanna - Who disagrees in the baraita with Rabbi Yosei ben Yasiyyan and Rabbi Yehuda the baker.

Rashi on Menachot 6b:22:1.hebrew: אי קמיצת פסולין עבודה היא - לפסול, אפילו לא נתן קומץ בכלי, לא תתקן בחזרה:
Rashi on Menachot 6b:22:1.english: If taking the handful by unfit [persons] is an act of service - [So as] to disqualify [the offering], even if he did not put the handful into a vessel, it should not be rectified by returning [the handful].

Rashi on Menachot 6b:22:2.hebrew: ואי לאו עבודה היא - דלא חשיב, הואיל ובפסולין נעשית, כי עבד מתן כלי נמי לא חשיב, ואפשר בחזרה:
Rashi on Menachot 6b:22:2.english: And if it is not an [act of] service - That it is not considered [an act of service], since it was performed by disqualified [individuals] — when he performed placement in a vessel, it is also not considered [an act of service], and returning [it] is possible.

Tosafot on Menachot 6b:16:1.hebrew: אלא טעמא דאשמועינן - בשום מקום לא פריך בענין זה, דקשיא ליה הכא: אמאי איצטריך ליה לרב לאשמועינן הא דתניא בברייתא? ושמא שגורה היתה בפי כל:
Tosafot on Menachot 6b:16:1.english: Rather, the reason that [Rav] taught us - In no [other] place does [the Gemara] object in this manner, that it is difficult for it here: Why was it necessary for Rav to teach us that which is taught in a baraita? And perhaps [this baraita] was fluent in everyone's mouth.

Tosafot on Menachot 6b:17:1.hebrew: ממקום שרגלי הזר עומדות - לקמן בפירקין מפרש: אצטריך, סד"א הואיל וכתיב והגישה וקמץ, מה הגשה בקרן מערבית דרומית, אף קמיצה כו'. ובקונטרס לא פירש כן:
Tosafot on Menachot 6b:17:1.english: From the place where the feet of the non-priest stand - Later in our chapter [8b], [the Gemara] explains: [The verse] was necessary, [for] it might enter your mind to say: Since it is written, "and he shall bring it near" and "and he shall scoop," just as bringing near [hagashah] is at the southwestern corner [of the altar], so too scooping, etc. [must be at the southwestern corner]. And in the Kuntres [Rashi], he did not explain so.

Tosafot on Menachot 6b:19:1.hebrew: וכיון דקרא סתמא כתיב מה לי שמאל כו' - וא"ת: בפרק המזבח מקדש (שם), דתנן שקיבלו פסולין וזרקו את דמן שאם עלה לא ירד, ומוקמינן לה בפסולין דחזו לעבודת צבור, ומרבי לה (הכא) מזאת התורה – ואמאי לא פריך: דכיון דקרא סתמא, מה לי חזו ומה לי לא חזו? ויש לומר: משום דדרשינן "זאת היא העולה" – הרי אלו מיעוטין:
Tosafot on Menachot 6b:19:1.english: And since the verse is written in an unspecified manner, what difference is it to me [whether with the] left [hand], etc. - And if you say: In the chapter [entitled] "HaMizbeach Mekadesh" (ibid.), where we learned in a mishna that [if] unfit [priests] received and sprinkled their blood, if it ascended [the altar], it shall not descend, and we establish it [as referring] to unfit [priests] who are fit for communal service, and it is included (here) from "This is the law [of the burnt offering]" — [then] why didn't [the Gemara] object: Since the verse is written in an unspecified manner, what difference is it to me whether they are fit [for communal service] or whether they are not fit? And one can say: Because we expound, "This is the burnt offering" — these are exclusions.
